title: Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)
summary: AIIMS Gorakhpur is inviting applications for temporary positions of Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) under an ICMR-funded extramural project via walk-in interview. Eligible candidates must submit their online application by November 29, 2026, and report for the interview on November 30, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Master's degree in Public Health, Biostatistics, Population Studies, Health Geography, or related disciplines from a recognized university.
Three years of research experience in a relevant field.
Maximum age limit is 40 years as on the last date of application.
how_to_apply_steps: Fill out the online application form via the provided Google Form link.
Submit the online form by 29th November 2026, 5:00 PM.
Bring a printed copy of the submitted form, a recent passport-size photograph, and original certificates for verification on the day of the interview.
